ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $\angle AOB=120^\circ$. OC is a ray inside $\angle AOB$, and $\angle AOC: \angle BOC=1: 2$. Draw ray OM to bisect $\angle AOC$. Inside $\angle BOC$, draw ray ON such that $\angle CON: \angle BON=1: 3$. What is the measure of $\angle MON$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that OM bisects $\angle$AOC,\\
$\therefore \angle$COM$= \frac{1}{2}\angle$AOC$= \frac{1}{2}\times 40^\circ=20^\circ$,\\
Since $\angle$CON$\colon \angle$BON$=1\colon 3$,\\
$\therefore \angle$CON$= \frac{1}{4}\angle$BOC$= \frac{1}{4}\times 80^\circ=20^\circ$,\\
Hence, $\angle$MON$=\angle$COM$+\angle$CON$=20^\circ+20^\circ=\boxed{40^\circ}$;
